description: This file provides utility functions to derive, validate, and suggest API base URLs based on environment variables and current window location, primarily used for configuring API endpoints in different deployment environments.

methods.name: suggestHostedApiBase(defaultPort = 3001)
methods.description: Generates a suggested API base URL for hosted/cloud environments by utilizing the current window.location's protocol and hostname, with a specified default port.

methods.name: isLocalHost()
methods.description: Determines whether the current window location is localhost or its IPv4/IPv6 variants.

methods.name: getApiConfig()
methods.description: Returns configuration details for the API base URL, including effective base, whether the environment is unset, if it looks local, if it's likely hosted outside localhost, and a suggested hosted base URL.
